slides.headline: Nine little worlds, one happy tablet
slides.body: Pretend play for ages 2 to 6. Works offline, no ads.

feed.caption:
Hello! We're KidPad 👋

KidPad is a pretend-play app for little ones aged about 2 to 6. Nine activities live on one bright home screen: a restaurant to run, train tickets to print, rescue callouts to answer, a clock, a timer, a calculator, a phone, a camera and a no-mess drawing canvas.

We built it to be the app you can hand over without hovering. It works fully offline, there are no ads, no accounts and nothing to buy inside. Settings sit behind a grown-up PIN.

One price, £2.99, on iPhone, iPad and Android. Link in bio.
